asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

boundaryCount.description: Number of pages to show at the beginning and end

defaultPage.description:
The initial active page when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the active page of the pagination.

defaultPageSize.description:
The initial number of data items per page when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the page size of the pagination.

getPageUrl.description:
Function to generate href attributes for pagination links.
Only used when `type` is set to "link".

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the accordion. Useful for composition.

onPageChange.description: Called when the page number is changed

onPageSizeChange.description: Called when the page size is changed

pageSize.description: The controlled number of data items per page
